notes: Pilot arm registry. pilot.py and pilot-score.ts contain no per-arm branches: an arm is defined only by its entry here. To add a reserved v2 arm: fill runner, dispatch, family, efforts, parityWith, toolpack and unsupportedTasks, set reserved to null, then register it with `pilot.py amend` (add-arm). Locked studies hash every entry they use, so editing an entry of a locked arm stops that study; only removing an unsupportedTasks entry may be amended (enable-cell).
